rules.summary: A secret, password or token is written into the script
The script changes state but does not support -WhatIf (no SupportsShouldProcess)
SupportsShouldProcess is declared but ShouldProcess is never called
The script changes state but does not default to a dry run
-Confirm:$false on a destructive command
A bulk change over every object (-All) with no filter, limit or guard
A script that only reads asks for a write permission scope
Execution policy is set to Bypass or Unrestricted
Code is downloaded and executed
Invoke-Expression is used
TLS or certificate validation is weakened
A tenant, object or application GUID is hard-coded
A security protection is switched off or excluded
The script creates a scheduled task, service or start-up entry
A secret or token is written to the console, a log or a file
The script changes state with no error handling
The script changes state but records nothing about what it did
An irreversible device action (wipe, retire, delete)
A Conditional Access policy is created or updated as enabled instead of report-only
Mail forwarding, redirect or mailbox delegation is changed
A directory role or privileged group membership is assigned
A user's authentication methods are removed or reset
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force on a variable or wildcard path
Errors are silenced on a command that changes state
A deprecated Azure AD or MSOnline module is used
A guardrail-allow comment has no reason
